# Agentware Studio

> Agentware Studio is an independent research and creation studio dedicated to Agentware—a class of software designed for the agentic era that shifts human-computer interaction from operating interfaces to delegating intent (`[ A↗• ] AGENTWARE — SOFTWARE THAT ACTS ON INTENT`).

Instead of operating interfaces step by step, you entrust software with a goal, define the boundaries, and specify the acceptance criteria; within its authorized scope, the system understands context, autonomously organizes actions, adapts to changes, and delivers verifiable outcomes. Agentware Studio advances this paradigm through deep research, an open AI engineering curriculum, and user-facing product experiments. The studio focuses on delivering goal-driven Agentware for consumers and private, high-governance Agentware solutions for enterprises.

## Documentation

- [Agentware Guide](https://agentware.studio/agentware.md): Comprehensive standalone Markdown guide covering the core definition, paradigm shift (Tool, Copilot, and Delegation eras), what Agentware is not, deterministic core and agentic control plane architecture, the eight-step execution loop, the four pillars, the six manifesto principles, and studio initiatives.
- [Agentware Studio](https://agentware.studio/): Official multilingual website presenting the Agentware paradigm, architecture comparison, interactive execution-loop walkthrough, four foundational pillars, and manifesto.
- [Public Access Policy](https://agentware.studio/auth.md): All public pages and documentation are accessible anonymously, including by AI agents; no registration, credentials, or Authorization header is required.

## Curriculum

- [Open Curriculum Overview](https://agentware.studio/learn/): Overview of the studio's open AI engineering curriculum (`We teach what we build.`) and the three seasons of its first course, *Graduating from AI Gacha* (`ai-fundamentals`, `ai-coding`, and `building-ai-systems`).
- [Course Platform](https://learn.agentware.studio): Learning portal for *Graduating from AI Gacha* featuring interactive practice games and a course-grounded AI assistant.
